raw_segments.text: At the base of the main mast, full beneath the doubloon and the flame, the Parsi was
kneeling in Ahab's front, but with his head bowed away from him.
While nearby, from the arched and overhanging rigging, where they had just been engaged
securing a spar, a number of the seamen, arrested by the glare, now cohered together and hung
pendulous like a knot of numbed wasps from a drooping orchard twig.
In various enchanted attitudes, like the standing, or stepping, or running skeletons in Herculaneum,
others remained rooted to the deck, but all their eyes upcast.
